title.zh: 规划（申请同意——豁免）公告 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Planning (Consent for Application — Exemption) Notification 2020 and comes into operation on 10 July 2020.

2. The Minister exempts Lot 96915K in MK 26 from rule 3(3) of the Planning (Development) Rules 2008 (G.N. No. S 113/2008) with regard to the application for written permission in relation to the proposed additions and alterations to an existing 2‑storey conservation terrace dwelling house which was submitted by Mr Tan Loong Tze to the competent authority on 28 May 2020.
